title: Limits of quantization from mixed to real polarizations on toric varieties
summary: Let $(M, ω, J)$ be a $2n$-dimensional toric variety determined by a Delzant polytope $P$, whose $T^{n}$-symmetry determines a real polarization $\mathcal{P}_{\mathbb{R}}$. Let $K \subset T^{n}$ be a subtorus. By a construction due to Leung and the first author, the $K$-action induces a mixed polarization $\mathcal{P}_{K}$. This paper investigates the relationship between the quantum Hilbert spaces $\mathcal{H}_{K}$ and $\mathcal{H}_{\mathbb{R}}$ associated with the polarizations $\mathcal{P}_{K}$ and $\mathcal{P}_{\mathbb{R}}$.
